lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 796 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did you go over there? You had this stuff planned out already, didn't you? You and Steve had this planned?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK and when did you plan it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. And what did you have planned? Tell me what you had planned. (pause) Come on. Brendan did you have this planned? Yes or no?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who did you plan it with?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: A few days before it happened.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and what did you have planned to do? (pause) The details are easy, come on, you've already given me that you were involved in it, so just go on with the details, paint a picture for me. Obviously I know already, I know a bunch of this already. I keep proving that to you. The details are easy, just tell me what you guys planned and what you did, no sweat.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I had sex with her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well let's back up a second. You said you planned this a couple days earlier, is that true or not? Yes or no?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, so where did you plan this, by Steve's house or your house, or in the car or what, up north, or what?
